unit.export_ordinal_scope: One full mdb-export before filtering, excluding its header. Keep linkage private and record the reader version.
unit.caladas_policy: Retain N_CALADAS and NUMERO_LANCE_EX. Flag missing, conflicting or multiple caladas and preserve original grouping.

reported_quantity.rule: Retain a finite nonnegative value only from one explicit species row on a complete candidate key, with no conflicting positive weight under code 999.
reported_quantity.zero_policy: Explicit zero remains a reported quantity with unvalidated semantics. Code 999 and target omission leave the hake quantity unset.
reported_quantity.multiple_species_rows_policy: Quarantine multiple target rows for review of scope before summing.

anchors.position_rule: Treat southwest DDMMSS parsing as a diagnostic. Verified capture position and approved pilot geometry are prerequisites for pairing.
anchors.environmental_rule: Keep environmental data separate until anchors are validated. Carry source and coverage provenance, including L3 availability and the mixed-coast diagnostic.

publication: Aggregate diagnostics only. Keep source records and candidate linkage private.
